basic_info.description: This superb Top Floor Condo is perfectly located on the best part of Noe Valley's most vibrant merchant street, the Castro. It is close but also a perfect distance to have a little space as well.  This condo has some truly amazing features you will love.  It can be flexible as Two or Three bedrooms.  As a full floor flat with in-unit Laundry and two areas that could be offices, this is just a Fab floor plan.  In addition, this condo comes with 2 car parking and a huge storage space in the garage.  Beautiful wood floors shine throughout this unit with classic detailing in the molding and yet top-end designer-finishes and upgrades throughout.  The kitchen features all stainless appliances like the gorgeous Thermador Gas Stove and large fridge and tons of cabinet space.  There is both a private backyard patio that is deeded to the unit as well as a large common area shared as well.  This is the top floor condo you have been waiting for
